extracted.intended_audience: USPTO patent examiners, applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants
extracted.subtask_short: using the MPEP for patent prosecution
extracted.subtask_description: Reference guidance on the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) as the authoritative source of practices, procedures, and examiner instructions for prosecution of patent applications before the USPTO. Points to related resources (laws, rules, eMPEP), archives, and contact channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP purpose and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: The Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP) is published to provide U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) patent examiners, applicants, attorneys, agents, and representatives of applicants with a reference work on the practices and procedures relative to the prosecution of patent applications before the USPTO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: It contains instructions to examiners, as well as other material in the nature of information and interpretation, and outlines the current procedures which the examiners are required or authorized to follow in appropriate cases in the normal examination of a patent application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to the latest published Patent Laws
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Laws - the latest published version of the patent laws
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP users should rely on the most current published patent statutes as part of examination and prosecution guidance (link provided on the MPEP page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refer to the latest published Patent Rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Rules - the latest published version of the patent rules
rubrics_metrics.guidance: MPEP guidance references the then-current rules of practice; users should consult the latest published Patent Rules for procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use eMPEP and supporting search/navigation aids
rubrics_metrics.description: For help with search features (e.g., default operators, proximity searches, and wild cards) and navigation see: User manual, Quick Reference Guide, HTML and PDF MPEP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The electronic MPEP (eMPEP) provides search/navigation tools and documentation (user manual, quick reference guide) to assist users in locating relevant MPEP sections and guidance efficiently.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access archives for prior MPEP editions when needed
rubrics_metrics.description: An archive of previous versions is available at: http://www.uspto.gov/web/offices/pac/mpep/old/index.htm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use archived editions to determine historical practice or to see prior formulations of procedures and examiner instructions relevant to older filings or retrospective inquiries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use provided contact channel for MPEP inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send communications via electronic mail to MPEPFeedback@uspto.gov to contact an editor of the MPEP or to send an inquiry to the MPEP staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Questions, suggestions, or requests for clarification about MPEP content should be directed to the MPEP staff through the provided email address.
